RULE.RULEITEM1: This page is a public welfare theme activity organized by Jackery for Earth Day 2023. It aims to encourage users to practice the concepts of energy conservation, emission reduction, and environmental protection with us and to implement Jackery's mission and vision of "making green energy everywhere".
RULE.RULEITEM2: The event starts from 0:00, April 22, 2023 to 23:59, May 21, 2023 (PDT).
RULE.RULEITEM3: Total CO₂ Cut refers to the credits users get by participating in the Jackery Earth Day event, which is calculated in grams (g). Users will get initial credits (Pledged CO₂ Cut) once they complete the willingness test (pledge) for carbon footprint reduction. Note that the Pledged CO₂ Cut is for illustration use only. Participants can increase their Total CO₂ Cut credits by completing tasks, which can be converted into membership points once the event ends. For more info, please check your email.
RULE.RULEITEM4: About the CarbonCut Leaderboard: Users will be ranked based on their Total CO₂ Cut. The leaderboard is updated in real-time. When participants have the same Total CO₂ Cut, the person who gained the credits first will be ranked higher. Real-time rankings will cease instantly once the event has closed, and rankings will be finalized. The top 50 ranked participants will receive the reward notification via email. If they do not respond as per the requirements contained in the email, the reward will be forfeited. Note that the first 5 rewards (to those ranked 1st to 5th) will be sent out on June 21st. The remaining 45 rewards (to those ranked 6th to 50th) will be sent out from May 22.
RULE.RULEITEM5: Every new user who participates in the event through your exclusive sharing link and completes the subscription is counted as a successful referral. Please note that you cannot recommend yourself, and subscribed mailboxes will not increase your Total CO₂ Cut.
RULE.RULEITEM6: Every release of qualified content in Jackery Life will increase your Total CO₂ Cut. Please note that the Total CO₂ Cut will be credited after the content is approved.
RULE.RULEITEM7-1: Following a successful share, you'll be directed to the page to claim your prize. Alternatively, you can also check your email for your winning information. If you haven’t received the email, please check the spam and trash box and add Jackery’s mailbox to the whitelist;
RULE.RULEITEM7-2: If you win the CarbonCut Pro badge, please click the link to jump to the Jackery personal center to redeem it;
RULE.RULEITEM7-3: If you win a gift card, copy and enter the coupon code at the checkout. The system will automatically waive the fee;
RULE.RULEITEM7-4: If you win a Jackery product (i.e. the Explorer 2000 Pro or, refurbished product), add the product to the cart and apply the coupon code at the checkout. The system will automatically waive the fee;
RULE.RULEITEM7-5: All coupons will take effect on the day the email is sent and are valid until May 31st, 2023. Once the coupon has been used, it can not be returned and reused.
RULE.RULEITEM7-6: Coupons for this event cannot be used with other event coupons. One order can use one coupon only.
RULE.RULEITEM7-7: A minimum order amount may be required for some specific coupons. Please check your email for more details.
RULE.RULEITEM8: Credits of Total CO₂ Cut for Each Task:
RULE.RULEITEM8-1: Complete the carbon reduction willingness (pledge) test +500g
RULE.RULEITEM8-3: Complete social media sharing (applies to first share only) +1000g
RULE.RULEITEM8-6: Complete qualified sharing in Jackery Life +500g/time
RULE.RULEITEM8-7: Complete an order purchase within the official website, and its CO₂ reduction will be added to your Total CarbonCut
RULE.RULEITEM8-8: You may lose the Carbon Cut you've gained if any product return is made during this period, which may affect your ranking and the exclusive gift you receive.
RULE.RULEITEM9: If you find that your Total CO₂ Cut record is lost, you can enter the email address again in the 'Vote for Your Favorite Carbon Footprint Reduction Project' section to restore the data.
RULE.RULEITEM10: Jackery has the final right to interpret this event.
